updates.note: Reiterated expansion of smartphone camera modules volume from 40 million units to 190 to 200 million units per annum.
updates.quote: We're expanding the capacities and deepening the level of manufacturing of camera and fingerprint modules for smartphone and target to expand volumes of smartphone camera modules from 40 million units in this fiscal to 190 million to 200 million units per annum.

Reiterated revenue target for IT products for next year to be around Rs. 3,500 crores to Rs. 4,000 crores.
updates.quote: We feel that for next year, the numbers are going to be somewhere around INR3,500 crores to INR4,000 crores.

new_promises.statement: Display module facility phase 1 trial should commence by Q2 of next fiscal.
new_promises.quote: In the first phase, we are creating a capacity of 24 million per annum for smartphones and 2 million units per annum for notebooks... and trial should commence by Q2 of next fiscal.
new_promises.speaker: Atul Lall

new_promises.statement: Mass production for front-loading washing machines to start by Q2 FY27 with annual capacity of 300,000 units.
new_promises.quote: Our new Tirupati facility for front-loading washing machine is ready and mass production to start by Q2 financial year '26-'27 with annual capacity of 300,000 units.
new_promises.speaker: Atul Lall

new_promises.statement: Total capex for the overall fiscal FY26 should be between INR1,100 crores and INR1,200 crores.
new_promises.quote: And we feel that in the overall fiscal, it should be somewhere between INR1,100 crores, INR1,200 crores.
new_promises.speaker: Atul Lall
